notes.title: Version Update 1.0.9a : Combat optimization in 3D mode
notes.notes:
[Version 1.0.9a]
Optimization: During battles, if you switch to the 3D view, there is now an additional “heart-shaped core” that allows players to lock the BOSS’s HP.

Optimization: Lowered the BOSS HP in the following stages: Orange Tutorial Stage and the first chapter’s practice stage
Orange Tutorial Stage [Phase01]: 266 → 140
Type C: 520 → 266
Type S [Phase1]: 376 → 266

Optimization: Adjusted the layer relationship between the “heart-shaped core”  and bullets. In short, smaller bullets will no longer be obscured by the “heart-shaped core”.

Optimization: Attempted to improve the collision experience of circular spreading bullets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39928151/0efa3f4352412af8c5603f66d0cf11ae1e2a70b2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Last Command Two-Year Anniversary! The New DLC Coming in 2025!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your passionate support and companionship over the past two years. It's all because of your participation that encourage us to bring more exciting content for the community. Today, we're thrilled to announce the first reveal of the DLC: [b]'Last Command B-SIDE'[/b] !

In the DLC story, players will join with Honest and venture into a mysterious laboratory, gradually uncovering the mysteries surrounding her. 

This perilous journey not only features bosses and mini-games meticulously designed by the developers, but also includes boss battles inspired by Kickstarter backers, bringing even more thrilling and fun challenges! Stay tuned for more updates!

Photosensitive Epilepsy Warning: This trailer contains flashing lights and rapid visual changes that may cause discomfort to players sensitive to light. If you experience any symptoms, please stop watching immediately and seek medical assistance.

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.8a : Fixed audio bug.
notes.notes:
【Patch version 1.0.8a】

Added: 
The Teleplot, Items, and Save Points are now displayed on the mini-map for enhanced navigation.


Added: 
A new Direction Indicators feature has been introduced, which can be activated via the 'Settings Page'. This feature displays an indicator for the dash direction


Optimization: 
Switching between gamepad and keyboard controls during gameplay now immediately refreshes the control tutoring tips.

If both a game controller and mouse are connected, you can now switch between them simply by pressing a button on the controller or keyboard.


Optimization: 
The 'Additional Settings' feature has been split into 'Additional Settings' and 'Appearance Settings'.

'Additional Settings' includes gameplay assistance options, while 'Appearance Settings' covers switches for visuals, themes, and styles.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 update!! Mini map and dialogue skip function are added now!!
notes.notes:
[h3]Patch 1.0.5 update!! [/h3]

Mini map and dialogue skip function are added now!! 
And there are few adjustment with modules.

Many thanks to all the feedbacks and from players.
There are some issue and suggestions that haven’t able to solve by this patch.
We will keep working on it and make the game better.
Thanks for your understanding.


[h3]Patch 1.0.5 content:[/h3]

- Added: Mini map.
- Added: The dialogue skip function.
- Added: A scheme for player who can’t load game with crashed auto save data. (Happened rarely)

- Optimized: The UI of player’s HP is more precise. 

- Fixed: In rare cases, players cannot obtain the module after defeating the boss. 
- Fixed: In rare cases, event is not trigged in Ch02 when player enter Circuit City.
- Fixed: The bug of ‘contacts system’ can be active with long press button.
- Fixed: Text spelling and grammar issue in English and S/T Chinese.
- Fixed: Optimize the urgent dodge system.
- Fixed: The confusing issue that Chinese character 「不」(No) was looked alike 「石」(Rock).
- Fixed: Pixel fonts bugs.
- Fixed: In final stage, player might die in the middle of the boss scene. It was triggered some unexpected display bug.
- Fixed: Change the NS pro controller icon.
- Fixed: Removed dialogs that are not related with current game system in the tutorial stage. 
- Fixed: Some small issues.

[h3]- Modules balancing [/h3]
【A1 Boundary Transmission】 Cool down time from 15 sec. to 13 sec.
【A3 Shock Collision】 Base damage change from 20 pts to 18 pts, and damage dealt by Dash path to unsolided health (gray part) increased from 3% to 6%.
【A5 Specs Specialization】Addition health restoring change from 3 pts to 2 pts each time. Energy restoring change from 12 pts to 8 pts.
【B4 Data Package】 Energy restoring by each data change from 5 pts to 8 pts .
【C4 Life Blooms】 Maximum health change from 40 pts to 30 pts.
【C6 Overclock Theft】 Maximum health reducing change from 25 pts to 25%.
【Module Resonance: Forever Green】New buff added. Increases maximum health by 10 points.
【S4 Data Creation】 Decrease energy cost from 600 pts to 500 pts.
【S3 Data Bombs】 Base damage increase from 100 pts to 105 pts; damage dealt by each data change from X50 to X43 pts.

-

notes.title: Last Command Japanese version localization & Controller Troubleshooting
notes.notes:
【 Japanese version localization】

We need to say sorry to players who is going to play Last Command in Japanese. The current Japanese translation is not perfectly localized. There are still some grammar and script errors that may affect players’ gameplay. We are sorry for that, and promise will fix them and update as soon as possible.
There will be an announcement once it’s fixed and uploaded. Thanks for your understanding.
　


【Controller Troubleshooting】

Q1：The controller seems not match with the control setting? All buttons are in the wrong set.
A：Right click on Last Command in your Library→Properties→Controller→Controller General Settings→unselect [Use Nintendo Button Layout] and re-launch the game.
　
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39928151/e98bfb913f4848a6ee5e625e731f539991d6d4eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39928151/37ce3cd335f777856bab123030bc786fb0f1c3e1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39928151/ce805911955f8f116fa6f06a07422bdc853bec47.png[/img]


Q2：My controller is a DualShock 4 (or other brand), but it is showing XBOX360 in game.
A：Right click on Last Command in your Library→Properties→Controller→Controller General Settings→select Disable Steam Input and re-launch the game.
　
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39928151/e98bfb913f4848a6ee5e625e731f539991d6d4eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39928151/882a9cd081442b1b764b2a63769e1652251b3092.png[/img]


If the problem is not fixed after above set up, it may because your controller is not compatible with Steam. You can report your controller brand and model to us via CreSpirit official site. (https://www.crespirit.com/contact-us/)
